canonical_project: RAIC Western Region Open Data Centre, Freetown
owner: Right to Access Information Commission (RAIC) Sierra Leone
notes: RAIC Western Region public data resource centre unveiled 2019-12-12 (46 Kroo Town Road, Freetown). Institutional public resource centre, NOT a commercial colocation or hyperscale data center. Note: Michcom-IX/SLIX/SLIXP internet exchange and Leonecom MMR (Jui) interconnection assets exist in Western Area but are treated as IXP/meet-me records, not independent data centers, per methodology.
